text:
reo: Quick note — after the kernel swap in canary I see a spike in workspace OOMs and KV eviction churn when prefill is enabled.

sam: repro? logs?

reo: repro script attached. curl to /generate with prefilling + long context. Steps:
```
curl -X POST https://canary.redwood/api/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -d '{"model":"rwd-4b","context_len":8192,"messages":...,"prefill":true}'
```

alejandra: saw similar in perf job 2026-03-01. p95 token latency up ~12% and kv_evictions/sec doubled.

eng-bench-bot: perf-job/2026-03-01: p50 23ms -> 26ms, p95 78ms -> 87ms, kv_evictions/sec 1120 -> 2380 :warning: 

mike: we swapped kernel selector to favor fused-attn for mid-length sequences, that increases workspace peak in some sequences. Could interact with prefill which reserves KV slots.

reo: hypothesis: prefill thin-cap interaction + slab fragmentation -> frequent small evictions, then decode path re-prefills causing churn and transient OOMs.

alejandra: can we try per-request soft-cap: cap_prefill_bytes = min(global_prefill, request_prefill_hint) and add 5% hysteresis before raising cap? avoids flip-flop.

sam: also try demote-small-chunks on eviction: prefer evicting small fragmented slots first to coalesce larger contiguous space.

mike: I ran a sim overnight. baseline: 32MB per-request prefill -> OOMs=34/day. soft-cap 24MB + 8% hysteresis -> OOMs=2/day, throughput -3% but p95 latency unchanged. frag metric improved ~30%.

reo: logs from the failing run:
```
[warn] allocator: out-of-space while allocating 6.0MB for KV; free_slots=14, largest_free=3.2MB
[info] kv: evicted 18 entries total; avg_size=48KB; fragmentation=0.68
```

ops-bot: rolled canary back; alert paged at 03:12 UTC. No customer impact reported.

alejandra: implementation plan: (1) add per-request soft-cap config and hysteresis (2) eviction policy switcher: size-aware-first candidate (3) add small-chunk demotion + compaction probe during low-load

sam: I'll draft PR for soft-cap + unit tests. mike, can you share sim scripts and data points?

mike: sharing link -> https://gdrive/redwood/perf/sim/prefill-hysteresis-2026-03-02

reo: thanks — let's pair tomorrow on rollout plan. tagging @mike @sam

sam: 👍
